## Introduction


Many Shopify post-purchase offers follow one script. The order goes through, and the thank-you page offers a percentage off a second item.


It's a fair tactic. But it teaches a shopper who just paid full price that the price was negotiable all along.


The thank-you page is the one moment a shopper has already said yes. That's a strong place to give them something to look forward to, not a markdown on the next thing.


This guide covers six post-purchase ideas for Shopify brands that keep the price where it is. One uses the conditional rebate that[Playably](https://playably.ai/) runs, where shoppers pay full price and can win 100% of their order back.


It's our blog, so our mechanic is on the list. The other five work with or without us.


### Key Takeaways


- Shopify post-purchase offers can reward a full-price order without another discount.
- Playably's gamified rebate auto-enters shoppers who buy at full price.
- The brand pays $0 of the rebate. Playably insures and hedges the payout.
- Surveys, subscriptions and full-price add-ons all fit the thank-you page.
- Soul CBD's campaign buyers subscribed at 59%, against 41% of other shoppers.


## Why Skip the Discount After Checkout


A post-purchase discount solves for one more sale. It can also tell your best shoppers to wait for the deal next time.


Discount codes still have a place, and many brands use them well. The question is whether the thank-you page is where you want to spend one.


Full price holds when the offer gives shoppers a reason to buy. Jordan Craig showed it during its NEWYORKFREE NFL Draft Rebate, when "93% of buyers walked past two 25%-off sitewide sales running the same month."


During that window, 1 in 8 store orders came through the rebate. The full results are in the[Jordan Craig case study](https://playably.ai/pages/jordancraig-case-study) .


## 1. Confirm the Shopper's Entry Into a Live Moment


This is the one we run. With a Playably gamified rebate, shoppers buy at full price and get auto-entered.


If a real, published trigger event hits, Playably pays them 100% of their order back by Venmo or PayPal, usually within days. You keep your price, and Playably insures and hedges the payout, so you pay $0 of the rebate.


That makes the moment after checkout something to look forward to. The shopper already paid full price, and now there's a real event to watch.


How the entry shows up after checkout is something the team maps for your store. Ask about it when you book the demo.


Triggers span sports finals, weather events and cultural moments, with new moments added weekly. See the current library on the[upcoming offers page](https://playably.ai/pages/upcoming-offers) .


## 2. Ask One Question, Get Zero Party Data


The thank-you page is a calm moment. A single question about preferences or plans can tell you things browsing data can't.


Keep it to one tap. What's it for, who's it for, or what would they like to see next.


Every Playably play works the same way at a bigger scale. It returns zero party data, meaning the preferences and intent shoppers reveal as they play.


That data feeds segmentation, recommendations and lifecycle flows long after the campaign ends. Our guide to[zero party data collection](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/zero-party-data-collection) covers what to ask and how to use it.


## 3. Invite the Subscription at Full Price


A shopper who just bought is the easiest person to invite into a subscription. You don't need a percentage off to make the ask.


Soul CBD's OVERTIME Big Game Cashback, which ran Jan 26 to Feb 7, 2026, shows what a full-price reason to act can do.


- 59% of campaign buyers subscribed, compared with 41% of other shoppers that same week.
- Brand-new buyers subscribed at 1.5× the rate of other first-time buyers, 54% against 36%.
- 63% of those subscribers renewed at least once, close to Soul's regular subscribers at 67%.


Those subscribers stayed, which is the point of asking in the first place. For more on keeping new buyers, see our piece on[interactive onboarding](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/interactive-customer-onboarding-setting-the-stage-for-long-term-loyalty) .


## 4. Recommend the Next Product at Full Price


A one-click add-on works without a discount if the product is the right one. Show the item that completes the order, not the one you need to clear.


Refills, accessories and the matching piece are the natural picks. Price them as they are on the product page.


Full price and bigger orders can go together. Soul CBD's campaign baskets came in 16% bigger than the rest of the store, $99 against $86.


Buckle Me Baby Coats founder Dahlia Rizk saw the same pattern. "Sales jumped 23% on launch, participant AOV rose 40%, and we never touched our price."


More levers are in our guide on[how to increase average order value](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/increase-average-order-value) .


## 5. Give Shoppers Something Worth Sharing


A plain "tell a friend" line is easy to scroll past. A live moment the shopper is now part of gives them something real to talk about.


Playably's guidance is that the best triggers are events your shoppers are already talking about. That's what makes the campaign spread on its own.


The brand gets the halo of the moment everyone's watching, without paying to sponsor it. And the shopper has a story to tell that isn't a coupon code.


The model has drawn outside attention too. Playably was featured in Inc. for its risk hedged rebate model, and you can read about the[Inc. feature](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/playably-featured-inc) on our blog.


## 6. Give Them a Game for Next Time


Not every shopper is ready to buy again today. A short game gives them a reason to come back that isn't a discount.


The[PlayAbly app on the Shopify App Store](https://apps.shopify.com/playably) is listed as free and needs no coding. It offers customizable game formats like swipe-to-shop and product matchups, and captures leads through challenges.


Its dashboard tracks engagement and insights in real time. That shows you which games bring shoppers back.


Games show up in the published numbers too. The Sak recorded 5x the conversion rate on its shoppable quiz.


## What Your Team Does


Your side of a Playably campaign stays small. Playably wires the campaign, the widget and the payout, with no dev work on your end.


Playably also supplies pre-built creative that runs across your store, email and paid, already built for your brand. Your team approves the brief, and Playably runs every one.


The commercial model is simple. Playably prices on performance, so you only pay when a sale happens, and your exposure is a small, fixed amount agreed in advance.


Most Playably campaigns go live in days rather than months. Read our breakdown of[cash back vs discount codes](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/cash-back-vs-discount-codes) for the margin math behind the choice.


## Conclusion


Shopify post-purchase offers don't have to end in a discount. The thank-you page can confirm a live moment, ask one good question, invite a subscription or suggest the right add-on at full price.


Playably runs the conditional rebate behind the first idea and insures the payout, so the brand pays $0 of the rebate. The other five work with or without Playably.
